unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate IBC by debtor,process stage and commenced provisions

payload.title: A listed process may not be generally commenced
payload.core_explanation_md:
For IBC research, identify the debtor category and the process: corporate resolution, liquidation or the relevant individual/partnership route. Then locate commencement, admission, moratorium, control, creditor decision and distribution provisions for that process. The existence of a Part or section in the index does not establish that it applies generally to every debtor.

The2026 amendment and commencement evidence must be reconciled with the June2026 exam cutoff. Rules, regulations and judicial treatment can add material conditions. Do not transplant a corporate voting rule into a different process or teach an old withdrawal provision as unchanged merely because the section number remains.

self_check.prompt_text: Does inclusion of an individual-insolvency chapter prove general commencement for all individuals?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Commencement and debtor-category applicability need evidence.

payload.stem_md: An author sees individual-insolvency headings and assumes every listed provision applies to every individual debtor. Which evidence is missing?

options.text_md: The relevant commencement and debtor-category instruments

payload.stem_md: A section number survives an amendment but its operative conditions change. Which version should a pinned exam item use?

options.text_md: The applicable text established by cutoff and commencement evidence
options.explanation_md: A stable number does not imply unchanged wording.
